reference.title: Settings and connections
reference.shortdesc: What a deployment is connected to, and the settings that control sign-in, the model and the free-tier budget.

property.propdesc: The Google sign-in client. Without it the deployment is read-only.
Comma-separated addresses that may start runs and decide rules.
Used by live runs only, inside the migration job. Never in code or in the API.
The migration job may use 48,000 vCPU-seconds a month. The Settings screen shows this month's use.
